# Chegg

> > Chegg's advertising platform connects brands with college students and Gen Z audiences through targeted marketing solutions.

Chegg College Marketing is a programmatic advertising platform designed to help brands reach and engage college students and Gen Z consumers. The platform offers multiple channels including email campaigns, influencer partnerships, and brand-safe advertising solutions to maximize campaign effectiveness.
